keyword: diesel pump on a grid building site

title.en: Can a diesel row be copied onto a grid-powered site?
title.zh: 柴油行能抄到有电网的工地上吗？

description.en: No. Stable power opens Electric 20–80 / HBT. Diesel rows are published for sites without stable grid power.
description.zh: 不能。供电稳定时打开电动20–80 / HBT。柴油行公布给没有稳定电网的工地。

h1.en: Can a diesel row be copied onto a grid-powered site?
h1.zh: 柴油行能抄到有电网的工地上吗？

directAnswer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the split on the selection guide: no stable grid means a diesel trailer or the rural diesel pump; stable power means Electric 20–80 / HBT. A building with a real motor supply uses the electric distance and aggregate rows. Copying Diesel 50’s 150 m / 450 m onto Electric 50, or Diesel 120’s 100 m³/h onto Electric 80, mixes tables.
directAnswer.zh: 不能。邢台河北品锦机械在选型指南里把界限写明：没有稳定电网用柴油拖泵或农村柴油泵；供电稳定用电动20–80 / HBT。真正有电机电源的建筑，用电动的距离和骨料行。把柴油50的 150 m / 450 m 抄到电动50上，或把柴油120的 100 m³/h 抄到电动80上，都是在混表。

heading.en: Similar names are not pairs of equal cells
heading.zh: 相近的名字不是相等的格子

body.en: Electric 40 is 21 m³/h and fine stone 120 m / 360 m. Diesel 40 is 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m with a 1 cm note in the introduction. Electric 60 is 40 m³/h on the grid. Diesel 60 is 35 m³/h off-grid. The word “40” or “60” is not a match.
body.zh: 电动40是 21 m³/h、细石 120 m / 360 m。柴油40是 26 m³/h、120 m / 360 m，介绍里有 1 cm 说明。电动60是电网上的 40 m³/h。柴油60是无电网上的 35 m³/h。“40”或“60”这两个字不是匹配。

heading.en: A weak grid is a fact to send, not a slogan
heading.zh: 电网不稳是要发送的事实，不是口号

body.en: If the supply cannot feed the motor kilowatts on the electric row, the site is in the diesel condition for that model. Say the voltage and the kilowatts. Xingtai can then stay on a diesel page honestly. Do not keep an electric model name and a diesel engine story on the same inquiry line.
body.zh: 如果电源供不起电动行上的电机千瓦，对那个型号来说现场就处于柴油条件。请写电压和千瓦。邢台就可以如实留在柴油页。不要在同一行询盘里既写电动型号又写柴油机。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: State grid or no grid before the model name. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 在型号名称之前写明有电网或无电网。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Are electric and diesel both made in Xingtai?
question.zh: 电动和柴油都在邢台制造吗？

answer.en: Yes. Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Renze Industrial Park. The factory address does not merge the tables.
answer.zh: 是。河北品锦机械，任泽工业园区。工厂地址不会把两张表合并。

question.en: Is there a dual-power trailer in this note?
question.zh: 本说明里有双动力拖泵吗？

answer.en: No published model here is both the electric table and the diesel table. Mixer pumps are electric or diesel as separate products.
answer.zh: 这里没有一台已公布型号同时是电动表和柴油表。搅拌泵的电动和柴油是分开的产品。

answer.en: The selection-guide question “Diesel or electric concrete pump?”.
answer.zh: 选型指南问题“选柴油泵还是电动泵？”。

alt.en: Electric 40 concrete pump from Xingtai, the grid-powered medium-building row rather than a copied diesel table
alt.zh: 邢台电动40型混凝土泵，有电网的中型建筑行，而不是抄来的柴油表
